{{Top}}
The term '''Chamberlain''' could apply to a variety of governing positions, often in place of a monarch or in control of a large jurisdiction.

The [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]], also had a chamberlain by the name of [[Adrenas]] who would look after maintenance and supply in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].

The Chamberlain was the planetary leader of [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]], most notably [[Iyon]].

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Galney (Lady)|Galney]] from [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] was a chamberlain to [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> In the end of the same year Lady [[Aros]] was chamberlain to Tenel Ka.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>
